# Someecards

> > Someecards is a humor and lifestyle website featuring funny ecards, viral AITA stories, relationship advice, entertainment news, and social commentary.

The site blends greeting card humor with modern internet culture, covering Reddit stories, relationship dynamics, and lifestyle content. Contributors include Bronwyn Isaac, Amanda Hurley, Taylor Brown, and Violet Roth, delivering relatable commentary on everyday situations.

## Key Topics

- AITA (Am I The A**hole) stories
- Relationship advice
- Ecards and greeting card humor
- Entertainment news
- Lifestyle stories
- Reddit stories
- Social commentary
- Relationship dynamics
- Bronwyn Isaac
- Amanda Hurley
- Taylor Brown
- Violet Roth
- Broadway and entertainment
- Viral content

## Main Pages

- [Someecards Homepage](https://www.someecards.com): Main homepage featuring funny ecards, AITA stories, relationship advice, and entertainment content
- [Development Homepage](https://devnew.someecards.com/): Development version of the homepage with news, entertainment, video, and ecards
